398:376.value: A photorealistic continuous studio portrait shot of the same smiling adult man shown in the first frame. He wears the same black open-collar shirt and gold chain against the same plain gray studio background. He breathes gently, blinks once naturally, and makes a small relaxed head turn of a few degrees before settling, keeping his familiar smile. His facial proportions, hairstyle, eyes, skin texture, clothing and jewelry remain consistent throughout. The camera stays locked at the same distance and angle. Soft studio lighting remains steady. Quiet room ambience, no speech or music. One uninterrupted shot.

review.decision: Capability demonstrated for image-to-video; performance and identity acceptance pending Ziggy. No extra generations submitted.
observations: 97 video frames decoded without a decoding failure. Twelve sampled frames visually inspected.
Small head tilt and expression motion; face, hair, black shirt, chain and gray studio background broadly consistent across inspected samples.
Eye closure appears in samples at 0.375, 0.708 and 1.083 seconds, and again at 2.917; not the requested single brief blink.
Broad smile relaxes rapidly into closed-mouth expression; requested smile preservation was incomplete.
No obvious scene cut or major identity replacement in sampled frames. Normal-speed temporal smoothness and audio content were not reviewed.
Browser security policy rejected local file playback; no alternate-browser workaround attempted. Codex file-panel open returned queued, not confirmed playback.
